title: UI demos 5-8 (approved by Alfredo)
summary: Alfredo approved demos 5-8 and requested the final spear-clearance refinement: the Unit Force ribbon slides down before the bow/katana enters, then returns after the tab retracts. Mendon review is required before merging; record UI/QoL feedback for Alfredo.
review_steps: Alfredo has approved the UI of demos 5-8. Merging into the main game is contingent on Mendon approving and required checks passing. No merge has been performed. This is the second review batch; the 1-4 package remains separately available on PR #396.

This replaces the earlier 552b54a4 review build and includes Alfredo’s latest spear-clearance refinement. Start Review.cmd opens demo 5 immediately. Quit between demos, then double-click a named Demo 5, 6, 7 or 8 launcher. Each opens its prepared scenario; no whole match or development setup is needed.

Demo 5 / issue #343 / PR #401: try the opposing-player Either/Or choices, review each consequence, inspect the source card and confirm. Check the other seat sees only appropriate public information. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/401

Demo 6 / issue #342 / PR #403: inspect the offered copied keywords/abilities, choose explicitly and confirm. Check the source, duration and remaining uses in the resulting card details. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/403

Demo 7 / issue #346 / PR #404: select a legal movement destination, inspect the existing battle-arrow preview, cancel or confirm, and try the prepared move/cost examples. Check every mover and attachment arrives at the engine-selected destination. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/404

Demo 8 / issue #355 / PR #410: use the Ranged and Melee demo buttons. The complete spear/Unit Force ribbon slides down first, then the bow/katana tab slides out above it without overlap; cancellation reverses the sequence. Choose a card or No target, retarget, cancel and try a reaction. The tab remains through the response and clears afterward. Reduced motion is immediate. Both spears and the live number must stay visible. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/410

Demo 8 also includes Follower, no-card, training-only Province, Carpenter Castle Cost and Tensin examples. Tensin marks and bows the selected performing Follower. Costs, permitted targets, reactions and outcomes remain authoritative in the engine.

Please record approval or requested changes on each demo’s PR. Note UI/QoL feedback with the demo number, steps and expected behavior; Alfredo will make the necessary changes. Send Feedback.url opens the batch discussion on PR #410.
known_limitations: Prepared local engine fixtures reach the decisions quickly. They do not establish full human matches, expert rules acceptance or external multiplayer acceptance.

The combined preview includes the preceding UI lineage and separately unapproved stabilization rules candidates (PR #275 and docs/handoffs/2026-09-20-eight-ui-review-plan.md). Alfredo UI approval does not approve inherited rules changes; resolve those dependencies with Mendon before integration.

AttackCueView and pending-attack presentation are optional read-only Core/server fields derived from the existing attack-kind registry. They identify the ability source or explicit performer, not a new legality, damage or payment calculation. Mendon shared-contract review remains required.
Automated Windows runtime startup and actual .cmd routing checks are distinct from a Windows graphical playtest. Mendon graphical/rules review is pending.
